date.source: The fed’s own newsdesk, 31 January 2003: “I have posted the card for the very first ICE. To be held on Saturday Febuary 8th. This card consists of 6 randomly selected match-ups” (promotions/gmwe/archive/news-2003-01.html).

evidence.note: The fed’s own news post announces the card, its date and its six matches; neither the card nor the results were ever captured.

date.source: The fed’s own ICE results index lists one entry, “02/12/03 - Results” (promotions/gmwe/archive/ice-results-index.html).

evidence.note: The only entry the fed’s own results index carries; the results page behind it was never captured.
